tasks.title: Implement repeatable catalog and offer audit
steps: Implement a no-network standard-library audit CLI. Parse current input, hash it, sort stable IDs and report counts by source/condition plus missing/invalid fields and duplicate identities.
Keep every source listing and its raw identity. Create draft canonical candidates; only mark a match accepted when exact evidence supports it. Similar names/URLs never prove equivalence.
Preserve reported availability and add whether it is observed, inferred or unknown. Missing shipping/fees and conditional discounts must not produce a verified complete total.

Select a reproducible stratified manual-review queue of up to 20 new listings; use approved/appropriate primary evidence when available. Retain rejected, unmatched and used records outside the proposed new-device set.
Write review counts, coverage limits and evidence references. Re-running unchanged input/config must preserve normalized counts/IDs; only run metadata changes.
Test duplicate IDs, absent fields, mixed conditions, ambiguous identity, unknown shipping, inferred stock and invalid integer money. Never overwrite data/*.json.
acceptance: Counts derive from actual rows, not hardcoded 70/55/15 assumptions.
